task-tracker-api.strong: In Task-Tracker API, SQLite can become a write bottleneck, so we enabled WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode and tuned SQLAlchemy connection pooling to 10 connections. For read-heavy operations, this allowed concurrent reads while WAL checkpointing happened in the background, reaching 350 read req/sec in our locust test.
task-tracker-api.terse: Enabled WAL mode and SQLAlchemy connection pool of 10 to hit 350 req/sec.
task-tracker-api.confidently_wrong: We deployed a globally replicated Apache Cassandra cluster with Raft consensus across 5 AWS regions to guarantee zero-downtime multi-master replication.
task-tracker-api.generic: We indexed database tables and used standard FastAPI async endpoints to handle requests.

mini-dns-resolver.strong: In Mini-DNS-Resolver, we implemented recursive UDP DNS resolution using Python's socket module. For cached queries, records are retrieved from our in-memory dictionary cache in under 45ms. For uncached queries, we parse RFC 1035 wire-format headers using struct to iteratively resolve A and CNAME records with a recursion timeout.
mini-dns-resolver.terse: Python sockets with struct parsing RFC 1035. Cached in dictionary under 45ms.
mini-dns-resolver.confidently_wrong: We configured Cloudflare Magic Transit and BGP Anycast route scrubbers with automated eBPF XDP rate limiting to mitigate 100 Gbps amplification attacks.
mini-dns-resolver.generic: We handled UDP packets with Python sockets and cached standard DNS queries in memory.

packet-sniffer.strong: In Packet-Sniffer, we opened raw AF_INET sockets in Python and used struct.unpack with '!BBHHHBBH4s4s' to parse the 20-byte IPv4 header, extracting the IHL field to calculate header length and inspecting the protocol byte for TCP, UDP, and ICMP.
packet-sniffer.terse: Raw AF_INET sockets with struct.unpack to decode IPv4, TCP, and UDP headers.
packet-sniffer.confidently_wrong: We deployed an Apache Kafka cluster with snappy compression and mirror-maker to stream 50,000 packets/sec into Elasticsearch and Splunk.
packet-sniffer.generic: Network packets were captured using sockets and inspected for protocol headers.
